text: Red Friday at the Holy Trinity Cathedral
Today is Good Friday – the most solemn day of Holy Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, His removal from the cross, and His burial.
The locum tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio, is performing the Great Hours, Vespers, and the Procession of the Shroud at the Patriarchal Cathedral of the Holy Trinity.

On Good Friday, no liturgy is celebrated in churches, because, according to the Gospel, the Lord offered Himself as a sacrifice to redeem humanity from its sins. During the service, the Royal Hours are performed, during which the Gospel about the Lord’s Passion is read.
